headline: Russia's Northern Sea Route Arctic Crude Shipments Reach Record 13.2 Million Barrels
summary: Russian tankers shipped a record 13.2 million barrels of crude and refined products to Asia via the Northern Sea Route in 2026, an 8% annual increase despite sanctions.
why: Arctic maritime routes allow Russian exporters to reduce transit times to Asian buyers.

impacts.name: Russia
impacts.why: Russia achieved record volume deliveries along its northern Arctic shipping corridor.
